observations.body: Some Egyptians fear the warning and protect servants and livestock. Pharaoh later says he has sinned, but once the storm ends he hardens again.
observations.label: Hail and Pharaoh’s temporary confession

observations.body: The passage presents Warning and sheltering as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Warning and sheltering

observations.body: The passage places Pharaoh and Egyptians who fear the word beside Warning and sheltering.
observations.label: Pharaoh and Egyptians who fear the word

payload.posture: Read Exodus 9:13–35 as one movement in Moses's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.title: Hail and Pharaoh’s temporary confession
